_doc: FLOW-DIRECTIVE-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-12): every loop declares its typed inflows, outflows (with the binding each travels on) and its feedback path, so its outcomes return as signals that change its next output. Read by foundation/flows.py (python3 -m foundation flows --check).
quote: How is this information flowing in? And what are we doing with it flowing out? And that applies to any workflow, any.

external_sources.ext.app_users: people who use a spun-off app on *.ultrastable.app (returned by app.launched as aggregate usage and verified-fix metrics, never personal data)
external_sources.ext.site_visits: readers of the public site (Cloudflare Web Analytics, returned by site.page)
external_sources.ext.post_engagement: replies, reposts and clicks on posts (returned by social.post)
external_sources.ext.owner_goals: IDEA.md and the owner's standing directives (instance manifest)
external_sources.ext.outreach_replies: funding programmes and recipients answering outreach (recorded by scripts/outreach.py reply)
external_sources.ext.actions_quota: GitHub Actions minutes used against the monthly quota
external_sources.ext.frontier: releases and posts of the leading agent platforms, coding agents and standards (doctrine/scout.json sources)
external_sources.ext.cf_analytics: Cloudflare GraphQL analytics: D1 rows read and Workers AI neurons per day (doctrine/cost.json budgets)
external_sources.ext.unlearn_adults: coaches and parents using Unlearn: they log curiosities and answer the 7 and 14 day follow-ups (instances/unlearn; no child data in phase 1)
external_sources.ext.unlearn_readers: readers of the Unlearn encyclopedia: their anonymous guesses and 'did this change your view' taps per entry (no identifier stored)
external_sources.ext.unlearn_literature: new systematic reviews and DOI records published on Europe PMC and Crossref, read by the Unlearn evidence step
external_sources.ext.ledger_literature: replication papers and their citation records published on OpenAlex, read from a GitHub runner by the Replication Ledger's OpenAlex mirror (OpenAlex refuses the Worker without a key)
external_sources.ext.supply_chain: OpenSSF Scorecard results and the SPDX SBOM GitHub's dependency graph exports for this repository (read weekly by supply-chain.yml)
external_sources.ext.config_files: configuration and ledger files that any worker or person commits to the repositories (read by openstd.yml against doctrine/open-standards.json)

qnfo-sauce.feedback: a closed item whose probe fails again reopens; a remedy that did not move its metric in the window is replaced; a family that keeps growing gets a doer item; the ignition gap count is read next to k on the following pass

tick-heartbeat.feedback: verdicts and readings from its own past ticks re-rank the next pull

agent-executor.feedback: a red check or a reverted merge files an item the next tick takes

change-gate.feedback: failing checks return to the executor as items

merge-lane.feedback: lanewatch measures time to merge and files a stuck PR

site-deploy.feedback: page visits return through the dashboard snapshot as metric readings

social-post.feedback: engagement returns through the dashboard snapshot and steers the growth items

dashboard-snapshot.feedback: its readings are the measures every other loop is judged by

predict-verify.feedback: missed predictions lower trust and revert the change

trust-ledger.feedback: scope widens or narrows from verified outcomes

temporal.feedback: a finding that persists escalates to the failure-mode audit and the pathfinder, and one that settles is recorded with how long it stood; a threshold that files items nobody settles is itself read as drift in the next run

failure-audit.feedback: a detector that keeps firing escalates and files its own redesign

product-manager-pass.feedback: a growth item is kept only if its metric moved

plussing.feedback: accepted pluses are scored by the metric they named

issue-triage.feedback: priority rises with age and with capability gain

planning-roadmap.feedback: roadmap items close only on their metric

funding-verify.feedback: a rejected or opt-out reply marks the registry row outreach:false, so the next verification and the next outreach run skip it

funding-outreach.feedback: replies move a target to replied, accepted, rejected or suppressed, which changes what the next run queues and follows up

outreach-send.feedback: each recorded reply returns to funding-outreach and funding-verify, and rewards its segment in the UCB1 order the next intro run queues by (foundation/outreach.py)

fleet-lane.feedback: drift found across repositories is filed as items the executor and the lane work next

index-refresh.feedback: the rebuilt index is the knowledge the executor reads for its next change

org-profile.feedback: the probe's state is read by the dashboard snapshot and a drift becomes a probe item

platform-core-tests.feedback: a failing core test blocks the merge and the executor fixes the change

actions-budget.feedback: the executor and the loops read the budget state and defer non-essential runs near the quota, which lowers the next reading

retriage.feedback: stale items are re-ranked or closed, which changes the next pull

branch-reaper.feedback: idle branches are closed or handed to the lane, which frees the executor's claims

public-transparency.feedback: readers of /live return as site visits the product manager reads as growth metrics

core-instance-sync.feedback: instance drift against the core becomes an item the executor works

launch.feedback: when no host wrote evidence for 12 h the failover runs the loops, and its own evidence resets the gate

running-system.feedback: the deploy count is a first-class metric the product manager and the clock read

executor-session.feedback: an opened PR is checked, merged and its outcome scores the next dispatch

scout.feedback: an adopted finding raises its source's weight and a declined or quiet one lowers it, so the next pass reads better sources and files fewer misses; shipped and stalled adoptions re-weight the source and set item priority (rnd.priorities), which the executor reads

a11y.feedback: a failed audit run is filed as an issue by the failure audit and taken by the executor; the next weekly run re-audits every page, so a fixed finding stops appearing and a returning one files again

cost-guard.feedback: a merged fix lowers the next day's reading; a breach that persists files an item the executor takes first

deploy-workers.feedback: a deploy whose live code differs from the commit files an item the executor takes next

open-loop-sweeper.feedback: a merged client PR shortens the next tick's open_loop_age_hours; a stuck one files a Q-OPENLOOP item the executor takes first

demo-video.feedback: each release update is attached to one social post (scripts/social_post.py video_post); views and engagement return through the dashboard snapshot and steer the marketing-manager storyboard edits

first-run.feedback: the first check it starts joins the merge lane; a copy where schedules did not come on keeps the manual Enable fallback

role-design-manager.feedback: a design variant is kept only when its metric moved beyond the pre-registered sample rule and no guard worsened (design experiments --evaluate); a lint finding that recurs files a Q-DESIGN item

promote.feedback: each recorded outcome (listed, replied, accepted, rejected, silent) moves its channel's weight in ops/promotion/weights.json, so the next plan ranks channels by what returned; a fact that changes (licence, public repo, entity) moves a programme in or out of fit by itself

blindspots.feedback: each recorded sweep answer resets its domain's clock and each learned need extends the register, so the next scan asks about what the last one found; a failed probe files its own item and passes when the work lands

provenance-loop.feedback: each change is settled kept or reverted from git history after the window; the kept rate per origin and actor retires or reinforces levers in the improvement ranker, so the next change is chosen from what the record says worked

insight-loop.feedback: each finding is settled 8 days later against what the page really got; the outcome tunes the rise threshold that classifies the next findings

criticality-loop.feedback: the lever changes which item each role takes next tick; the next measured k_eff grades the logged prediction, and a miss reverts the lever and files CRIT-LEVER

ultrastability-loop.feedback: a step changes a parameter or files a restructure item; the next readings grade the logged prediction, keep the step when the variable is back inside its bounds and otherwise undo it and take the next step

branch-sweep.feedback: a merged branch leaves the next scan empty; a ported branch becomes a PORT-BRANCH item the executor takes, and the next scan stops listing the branch once main carries it

loop-proof.feedback: each tick reads the beats its own loops left in earlier slots; a loop that missed its slots becomes MISSED-<loop> at the head of the tick's queue and is closed by the same reading once the loop ticks again; the watchdog beat from the site Worker is judged like any other loop

ignition-ladder.feedback: the stage read this tick is compared with the stage read last tick; a rise or fall is appended to ignition_log, and the first unmet stage is filed as IGNITE-<stage> in the tick's own queue with the numbers that block it, so the next ticks work on what keeps the system from criticality

publication-guard.feedback: a violation fails checks and the fleet drift run files an issue in the repository that lost the file; the next run passes only when the file is restored, and the SPDX baseline only shrinks

unknowns.feedback: each answer (gap, new objective, none, cannot-know) is a ledger row that lowers that question's novelty and raises the score of its loop when a gap was found; a gap or new objective becomes a probationary objective candidate and seeds the next pass, so the questions move toward where the system was wrong

spinoff.feedback: each app's verified fixes, retention and reach to people with the gap are read back by the next tick; a retired app lowers its archetype's bandit weight and a promoted one raises it, so the next ideation ranks differently

ciwatch.feedback: a Q-CIFAIL item closes only when its workflow's newest default-branch run is green (probe), a red run that reappears reopens it, and the ledger is read on the next pass to rerun transient failures at most once

claims-conformance.feedback: a drift files a Q-CLAIM item the executor fixes by merging a change; the next check reads the fixed words and the claim count rises

workers-tests.feedback: a failed run is filed as an issue by the failure audit and taken by the executor; the next change under workers/ re-runs the tests, so a fix stops failing and a regression files again

issue-loop.feedback: a passing probe closes the issue and the open count falls; a failing or missing probe stays open and the executor takes it next

resilience.feedback: a restart is graded by the next beat: the clock is ticking again or the restart counts toward escalation (Q-STALL item after two failures); the stalled count is the essential variable stalled_clocks, so a stall that persists becomes an Ashby second-order step

tenant-sync.feedback: each run reads the ledger of its own earlier runs; a tenant still needing a PR after the previous run, or a lift PR that never merged, is counted again and the lane merges the PRs it opened

uiux-loop.feedback: a front-end fix item closes only when its probe re-runs the audit for the pages it names and the finding no longer reproduces; an experiment arm is promoted only when its metric moved past the pre-registered sample with the guard intact; the two essential variables (ui_findings, happy_paths) feed the slow loop that restructures when they stay out of bounds

role-uiux-manager.feedback: a path or audit finding becomes a Q-UIUX item with a probe; an experiment arm is kept only past the pre-registered sample with its guard intact (uiux --experiments); the next audit shows whether the fix held

regen-generated.feedback: the bot's commit changes main, and the next merge's run finds the data current (no commit) or refreshes it again; a generator that fails fails the run and is seen by the workflow watch

hosts.feedback: a push with no deploy event after 30 minutes is redispatched through the GitHub Actions host; a host that fails health or a deploy is skipped for the next host and its failure is a red commit status the lane reads; host events return through /hook/host as statuses

host-sync.feedback: each run compares the host with the expected hashes its earlier runs and deploys recorded; drift that survives a redeploy is read again and counted by the next run

role-portfolio-manager.feedback: the constraint it sets is scored by the next criticality reading: an allocation that did not raise k or lower cost in its window is rebalanced and the cause is filed

role-project-manager.feedback: an item past its SLA or a pull request that failed its checks comes back as the next tick's first item; delivery time per outcome is read before the next claim is planned

role-product-manager.feedback: each plus it ranks carries a prediction; the settled outcome (metric moved or not) changes the next ranking and the roadmap order

role-staff.feedback: a claimed item ends as a pull request; a failed check or a reviewer veto returns the same item with the reasons, and three failures park it for a different doer

role-reviewer.feedback: a review verdict is scored against what happened after merge (a reverted or reopened change counts against the reviewer's surface in the trust ledger), and every review files one plus

role-operations.feedback: a workflow over its minute budget, a failed deploy or a cost breach files an item; the next reading of the same budget shows whether the remedy held

role-funding-manager.feedback: a reply or a closed programme changes the registry entry it came from; a programme that keeps rejecting drops in fit and one that answers rises

role-outreach-manager.feedback: replies re-weight which programmes and segments get the next packet (foundation/outreach.py for intro segments); a guard failure on a packet files an item instead of a send

role-outreach-coordinator.feedback: an opt-out or bounce suppresses the target for good, a reply stops its follow-ups, and a cap that was reached defers the rest to the next run

memory-fresh.feedback: a change that leaves the project memory stale fails its check and comes back to its author with the stale section named

write-back.feedback: a change with code and no write-back record fails its check; the record it then writes is read by the next session and the executor's knowledge tier

loop-registry.feedback: a loop with no trigger, owner, probe or second path fails the check on the change that introduced it; the verifier's result is the registry's own next input

glossary.feedback: a term changed without a version bump and lineage fails the check; the regenerated glossary is what agents and the dashboard read next

doctrine-check.feedback: a listed file that drops a required line fails the check on that change; doctrine --apply writes the line back and the next run confirms it

recognition-lint.feedback: a report or lesson that hands work back is flagged before it lands; a signature that keeps recurring becomes a doctrine amendment proposal

doctrine-amendment.feedback: an amendment is adopted only after it is tested against recent ticks; if the friction it answers recurs after adoption the amendment is reopened

gap-register.feedback: a gap closes only when its probe passes; a closed gap whose probe fails again reopens and is filed

guiding-directive.feedback: each probe of the registers and the accounting invariant is logged; an imbalance or an unprobed entry files an item, and the next probe confirms it is gone

durable-facts.feedback: a required fact missing from the repository fails the check and files an item; the fact written back is probed on the next tick

doc-consumption.feedback: an orphan document fails the build; a document that tells a person to act becomes a backlog item, and the baseline only shrinks

liveness.feedback: a loop with no fresh evidence files an item against that loop; the next pass reads the same evidence and closes the item when the loop has run

server-side-only.feedback: a change that names a host, scheduler or route on a person's computer fails the check on that change; a new banned pattern is added when a miss is found

orphan-artifacts.feedback: orphans and waits are counted each pass against a shrink-only baseline; a count that rises fails the change that raised it

containment-boundary.feedback: the daily drill rebuilds the inside from the repository; a drill that fails files an item and the next drill is the proof

session-reaper.feedback: each sweep records how many sessions it left; a count that does not fall files a plus against the reaper's own weakest step

market-gaps.feedback: a claimed feature with no passing proof fails the check; every gap is a queue item, and a shipped gap is re-scored on the next pass

strange-loop-hygiene.feedback: each sweep records its own leftover count as its cycle metric and files a plus when the count did not beat the last sweep

role-research-publisher.feedback: a published finding carries its sources; a source that changes or a claim that fails its probe reopens the finding

role-marketing-manager.feedback: copy, posts and channels are kept only when the metric they target moved; a channel with no outcome decays

role-legal-ip-manager.feedback: a failed notice, licence or name check files an item; the same check on the next tick shows whether it was fixed

role-customer-success.feedback: an instance whose health metric breaches gets an item; feedback routed to the product manager is scored by whether the fix moved that instance's metric

role-org-designer.feedback: a role is activated only when its phase gate passes (foundation/team.py) and is retired when its metric stays idle

triggers.feedback: a workflow whose schedule drifts from doctrine/triggers.json fails the check; a missed heartbeat is read from the clocks and files an item

lifecycle.feedback: the improver scores each loop's last change and its own; a change whose score fell is reverted on the next pass

components.feedback: components, stories and objections are recomputed from probes each pass; a gap that closes drops out and one that reappears is refiled

agent-interop.feedback: a standard whose surface or conformance check fails blocks the change; its status in the register is recomputed, never typed

terms-crosswalk.feedback: an avoided synonym in an instruction file fails the check on that change; the map grows when a new overlap is found

code-agents.feedback: an adapter without an invocation, a cost or a disjoint reviewer family fails the check; recorded outcomes re-route authorship to the cheaper adapter that passes

role-program-manager.feedback: the sequence it sets is read against the next k: when k is below its floor, deploy-raising and cost-cutting work moves first and the reordering is scored on the following reading

role-infrastructure-manager.feedback: a resource that differs from the topology or a budget breach files an item; the next discovery pass confirms the resource matches

smoke-live.feedback: a failing public claim files a Q-SMOKE item that the executor works; the next daily run passes and removes the item, or keeps it open with the same evidence

backup-drill.feedback: a failed restore files an item and the smoke test reads the restore record the next day; a restore that stays unproven stays a failing claim

research.feedback: each finding's measurement is re-read every pass: a finding not met files a Q-RES item that the executor works and whose closing probe is the same measurement, experiments settle against their predictions and reopen, and the papers at /research are regenerated from the new numbers

thought.feedback: every paper regenerates from the measurements after a merge; a changed result is posted first, and referrals from the posts to /research return through the reach loop's paper arm, which moves the arm weights

yearfail.feedback: a failing or uncovered month becomes a Q-YEARFAIL item the executor fixes and merges, and the next weekly run must turn that month green; the result is published at /year

unlearn-beat.feedback: each 14-day answer (did the child keep going on their own) re-weights the move that was given, so the next adult is offered moves that kept children exploring; the measured gates open the next phase; for the encyclopedia, each beat's evidence check (resolved DOIs, new reviews) is read by the next beat to pick the stalest entries and skip resolved sources, new reviews queue an entry for re-grading, and reader surprise counts re-order the home page

intent-yield.feedback: a directive that is not holding becomes a Q-YIELD item closed by its own probe; a restatement is charged to the directive it repeats, so the next run reads whether the system made it true without being told twice; each run's prediction of the kept share is scored after the settle window

seed-launch.feedback: a failed seed stage fails seedlaunch --check, the failure-audit detector seed-launch files Q-AUDIT-seed-launch, the executor fixes seed/ and the next weekly run re-launches against the merged fix

tenant-repos.feedback: each daily run compares every moved tenant's main with the source_sha its last live-verified deploy recorded, so a deploy that failed or never ran is dispatched again the next day

fleet-map.feedback: each daily reading of every copy against its source is recorded; a copy that is not equal files Q-FLEETMAP-<repo>, and the next reading closes the item or keeps it open, so a sync that stopped working shows within a day

improve.feedback: each closed Q-IMPROVE item is judged a week later on its metric: kept if it rose, else a replace item is filed; a tier with no merge in its window files its own stall item, which closes when a merge lands

findable.feedback: a property's gaps return as a Q-FIND item the executor fixes, and the next daily reading closes it or keeps it open

replication-ledger-openalex.feedback: each run reads the mirror already on main and rewrites it only when OpenAlex's answer changed; the ledger Worker's beat reads the deployed mirror when OpenAlex refuses it and files attempts under the verbatim-quote guard, the findings it adds are listed by /api/findings and become the next run's questions, and the live /health generated_at is compared with main's so a mirror that did not reach the Worker is redeployed

managers.feedback: a manager with no loop, code, clock or probe fails managers --check on the change that caused it; a switched-on manager with no runtime row is hired by the next tick's reconcile step, and one that stays missing or stopped fails the detector managers-live, which files Q-AUDIT-managers-live for the executor

supply-chain.feedback: each Scorecard check under the floor and each package outside the licence policy is filed as a Q-STD-SC-* item; the fix lands, the next weekly reading is the item's closing probe, so a check that recovers closes its item and one that does not stays on the executor's queue

openstd.feedback: each drain shrinks the baseline and the next check fails on any file the drain missed; a baseline that stops shrinking files a Q-STD item through the failure-mode audit

cleanroom.feedback: a capability that does not come up in the sandbox becomes a Q-CLEANROOM item whose closing probe is the same clean-room check; the next run closes it when the seed brings the capability up on its own
